description: Discover this exceptional private mansion located in the heart of the village of Auteuil in the 16th arrondissement of Paris, benefiting from a large garden of 350 m². This exceptional mansion combines the charm of the old with a high-end contemporary renovation with subtlety and elegance. Bathed in light and opening onto a peaceful garden without overlooking, it offers a rare and refined living environment, ideal for hosting a family, guests or private events.The spaceThis 515 sqm mansion on two floors is composed of an extensive bright living room with beautiful original parquet, an English-style boudoir, a fully equipped professional kitchen, a kitchenette and a laundry room. On the ground floor, a cinema room that can be converted into a meeting room, as well as a gym, complete this exceptional property.The sleeping area includes seven bedrooms spread over several levels, including two sumptuous master suites and one child's room, as well as six bathrooms.Accommodation not suitable for people with disabilities.
